administrative_race_model.locks: Before state capture, LOCK ONLY mf.fund_variants and mf.current_fund_facts IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT, deterministic order. View LOCK recursively locks underlying relations: this is explicitly a bounded potential availability impact, NOT an ordinary harmless metadata read. No wait/timeout raise; original5s/15s bounds. administrative_race_model.acl_races: PostgreSQL18 source objectNamesToOids normally AccessShareLock, so ACCESS EXCLUSIVE excludes direct relation/column GRANT/REVOKE and DDL. ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA expansion can skip normal object-name relation locks, therefore do NOT claim target locks universally exclude all ACL writes. ExecGrant_Relation uses SearchSysCacheLocked1(pg_class) and catalog tuple locks; correction's two fixed GRANTs serialize on those tuples. Capture complete exact before state after relation locks, do fixed twoGRANTs, then new READ COMMITTED snapshot and compare exact expected delta, all root/column ACL grantor/options and unrelated metadata/capabilities. Any prior/intervening schema-wide ACL change mismatches and ROLLBACK. Other-object/role/default-ACL concurrency remains governed by administrative window and exact whole metadata comparison; no assertion TOCTOU impossible under arbitrary admin bypass.
administrative_race_model.visibility: Do not claim pg_locks or pg_stat_activity proves absence of all other admins. Extra queued ACL/DDL writers can be rejected if visible, but visibility is not administrative-window proof. Final receipt explicitly records this trust boundary and no postcommit permanence guarantee. Native races test actual target GRANT/REVOKE/viewreplace/drop/OID changes and schema-wide ACL interference with synchronization, not sleeps-as-proof.
administrative_race_model.commit: Consume local single-use capability before write/ambiguous IO; persist START outside this engine only by separately delivered transport. Engine sends COMMIT once. If it raises, label COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and STOP; do not send ROLLBACK/reversal/reconnect/retry or synthesize success. Successful returned COMMIT followed by failed final verification is COMMITTED_UNVERIFIED, never automatically reversed without separately authorized exact reversal. Precommit failures ROLLBACK once and STOP.
